item.text: {"iteration":3,"pcvs":[{"name":"new_block_count","expression":"sum(max(0, (num_tokens_need_slot + manager.block_size - 1) // manager.block_size - len(manager.req_to_blocks.get(request.request_id, ()))) for manager in self.coordinator.single_type_managers)","rationale":"Retains the dominant distinction between allocation and no-allocation paths."},{"name":"num_tokens_need_slot","expression":"num_tokens_need_slot","rationale":"Preserves sequence extent and sufficient distinct entry states."},{"name":"tracked_requests","expression":"len(self.coordinator.single_type_managers[0].req_to_blocks)","rationale":"Measures request-table occupancy, which can affect insertion and allocation bookkeeping costs."},{"name":"cached_blocks","expression":"len(self.block_pool.cached_block_hash_to_block)","rationale":"Distinguishes initial pool use from warmed prefix-cache state and captures cache bookkeeping occupancy."}],"hypothesis":"The large deviations occur in early allocations.
